title: AMEX contactless CVM 处理（See Phone：上手机完成 CVM 后二次挥卡，脱机批准）
summary: Expresspay Mobile「See Phone」流程：AIP=18C0（byte2 bit8 = 支持移动/CDCVM）、CVM List 16B（X/Y=0 + 4203/5E03/5F03/4100）。首次读卡时卡端在 GPO 应答里给 9F71=010001（移动 CVM 未完成），内核 emv_cardholder_verification.c:894（mob_cvm_res[2]==0x01 且 gExpressmobileagain==0）置 gExpressmobileagain=1 并返回 EMV_REQ_SEEPHONE=107；POS 必须提示持卡人「See Phone」、非接下电 1.5s 后重新检卡上电，并**继续同一内核上下文**（不能重新 initialize/preprocess，否则 gExpressmobileagain 丢失会再次要上手机）。第二次读卡时卡端给 9F71=010002（移动 CVM 已完成），内核跳过 See Phone 分支进入 CVM_Processing(FALSE)：因 CVMRLEF=0 且 CVM List 含 5F03（No CVM required，condition=03），内核优先取该规则（emv_cardholder_verification.c:674-704），express_CheckIfSupportCVM(0x1F) 判 9F33[1]&0x08=0x08 → 支持 → performCVM 返回 CV_SUCCESS → 9F34=5F0302，随后 GENERATE AC 走 TC（acBehavior=offline_approved）→ 交易结果应为脱机批准。参考日志（CVM PROC 80 XPM「二次拍卡没上电」）只到 NXT(107)/emv_process ret=107 就再无 APDU —— 即旧版 POS 未处理 107，本案例即以「二次读卡走完 GAC 并脱机批准」为通过条件。

operator_instructions.notes: 15.00 EUR: 第一次挥卡后 POS 应提示 See Phone；在手机上完成验证后再次挥卡（第二次）

preconditions: phone NFC enabled and card simulator app in foreground

POS terminal configured with CONF_01 + PROFILE_02; PROFILE_02's term (9F33=200888, 9F6E=9C800003) is the module that reproduces the reference log's 9F33=200888/9F6E=9C800003 and makes express_CheckIfSupportCVM(0x1F) true (9F33[1]&0x08)

CVMRLEF must be 0 for this amount: the log prints 'in emv_cardholder_verify_temp g_emv_cnxt->CVMRLEF = 0' before NXT(107); a CVM limit of 0 (CVM-PROC101's PROFILE_02 use) would instead take the 8.2.2 branch

the card profile carries the two-step 9F71 sequence (mobileCvmResult=010001 on the first GPO of the emulation session, mobileCvmResultRetap=010002 from the second on); the GPO counter survives the field power-down between the two taps and is reset per emulation session (start_emulation/profile load)

the reference log masks PAN (5A=FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) and Track2 (57=FF…19B), so the profile uses a Luhn-valid test PAN (340000080000002, checked by the case loader) with panSequenceNumber 0 (log 5F34=00) and a derived ASCII track2; every other profile value is taken verbatim from the log (AID FCI 50/5F2D/9F38 and record 8C/8D/9F70/9F08/9F07/5F28/9F42/8E/5F25/5F24)

expected CVM Results after the re-tap: 5F0302 — emv_cardholder_verify → CVM_Processing(FALSE) picks the 5F03 (No CVM required) rule because CVMRLEF=0, its condition 03 is supported (9F33[1]&0x08) and express_PerformCVM(0x1F) returns CV_SUCCESS (emv_cardholder_verification.c:597-599, 674-704)

test_plan.action: host pushes the card profile (AIP 18C0, CVM List 4203/5E03/5F03/4100, 9F71 sequence) with CONF_01 + PROFILE_02 and starts emulation
operator taps the phone once; the kernel returns EMV_REQ_SEEPHONE(107)
test_plan.expect: the card's first GPO response carries 9F71=010001 and the POS shows the See Phone prompt

test_plan.action: POS powers the field down, waits ~1.5s, re-detects the card and continues the SAME kernel context (no re-initialize)
test_plan.expect: the card's second GPO response carries 9F71=010002 and the flow reaches GENERATE AC

test_plan.action: host judges the CTEL2 out of the second read
test_plan.expect: outcome=approved / online=offline / resp_code=00 and the DataRecord 9F34 = 5F0302
